Scientist Awarded $100,000 Prize for Decoding Zebra Finch Birdsong

A scientist, Julie Elie, has been awarded a $100,000 prize for her work in decoding the communication of zebra finches. Elie's research revealed how these birds announce their identity, their activities, and utilize individual signatures in their birdsong. This achievement is recognized as a significant step towards enabling human-animal communication.
